purpose: Candidate-coverage review only. These are visible image-change groups, not electrical fault truth, Labelme annotations, or training labels.
source_basis: Manual reference-versus-aligned-image comparison, with candidate boxes cross-checked afterwards.

review_policy.candidate_coverage_rule: A candidate box intersects the group box.
excluded_content: ambiguous global AI repaint or frame variation
subtle label-level or photometric mutation that cannot be reliably grouped
